items.exampleEn: The train leaves at exactly six o'clock.
You can wear whatever clothes you want.
items.exampleZh: 你想穿什麼衣服都可以。

items.exampleEn: She looked at herself in the mirror.
It was indeed a very good idea.
items.exampleZh: 那的確是個非常好的主意。

items.exampleEn: I would rather stay home tonight.
We had no tea, so I drank coffee instead.
items.exampleZh: 我們沒有茶了，所以我改喝咖啡。

items.exampleEn: Somebody is knocking at the door.

items.sentenceEn: Please step forward when I call your name.
items.sentenceZh: 我叫到你的名字時，請往前站一步。

items.audioEn: There was no milk, so Lucy had juice instead.
items.audioZh: 牛奶沒有了，所以 Lucy 改喝果汁。

items.sentenceEn: You can order whatever food you like.
items.sentenceZh: 你喜歡什麼菜都可以點。

items.sentenceEn: I would rather walk than take the bus.
items.sentenceZh: 我寧願走路，也不想搭公車。

items.stemEn: There was no rice, so we ate bread ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有米飯了，所以我們改吃麵包。

items.passageEn: Emma's little sister, Mia, is only six, but she likes to do things herself. This morning, Mia wanted to make breakfast. "I'd rather do it myself," she said. She put bread and eggs on the table, but she forgot the milk, so she gave Emma juice instead. "This is exactly what I wanted!" Emma said. Indeed, it was a lovely breakfast.
items.passageZh: Emma 的妹妹 Mia 才六歲，卻喜歡自己做事。今天早上，Mia 想做早餐。她說：「我寧願自己來。」她把麵包和雞蛋放到桌上，卻忘了拿牛奶，所以她改給 Emma 果汁。Emma 說：「這正是我想要的！」那的確是一頓很棒的早餐。

questions.questionZh: Mia 今天早上想做什麼？

items.promptZh: 她去年自己一個人去旅行。
referenceEn: She traveled by herself last year.
Last year, she went on a trip by herself.
rubricZh: 「自己一個人」用 by herself（寫 alone、on her own 也正確）
去年的事用過去式（例如 traveled、went）

items.promptZh: 他寧願一個人工作，也不要和別人一起工作。
referenceEn: He would rather work alone than with other people.
He'd rather work by himself than with others.
rubricZh: 用 would rather（'d rather）…than… 表示「寧願…也不要…」
「一個人」可寫，例如 alone、by himself 等
than 後面可省略動詞（例如 than with others），也可寫完整（例如 than work with others）
